description: Active, priced, in-stock variant of a published configurable product with exactly addOnGroups add-on groups (one active in-stock add-on per group, at most 3) and personalizable attributes, for a collection that orders it.

quantityUsed.description: Quantity ordered of the variant and of each add-on

addOnGroups.description: Exact number of add-on groups on the variant (1 to 3); every group gets one add-on in the order

minPersonalizableAttributes.description: Personalizable attributes the variant or its parent must have (0 or more)
